body.p: on the owner's word: "We want to target the newest draft for the XSLT tests." Amends , which pinned the grammars to the drafts of 13 October 2026 and let those drafts win over the test suite.

item.p: sxml's XSLT 4.0 follows the newest editor's draft published by the QT4 Community Group (qt4cg.org), and the xslt40-test suite is kept at its newest commit ('s update script). Both are refreshed together, with the draft's date and the suite's commit recorded.

Where the newest draft and the suite agree, sxml follows them, also where that changes behaviour an older draft decided (the priority set and its "~T" patterns, 4.19/). Where they still disagree, the newest draft wins and the case is recorded with the draft section, as did.
The XPath 4.0, XQuery 4.0 and F&O 4.0 drafts the XSLT draft depends on are refreshed at the same time where XSLT needs it; the rest of QT4 follows the same rule when its suite is next refreshed.
